key_findings: STX1A overexpression from 7q11.23 duplication likely causes pain insensitivity; excess syntaxin1A inhibits capsaicin-evoked CGRP release from DRG neurons (biphasic dose effect).
STX1A is coexpressed in essentially all TRPV1+ human DRG neurons.
